content.thinking:
SQLite 3.50.4, using the autosetup configure script. Configure with gcov flags:

`./configure CFLAGS="-O2 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage"`

Actually `--coverage` handles both compilation and linking. But explicitly: CFLAGS="-O2 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage" and also LDFLAGS="--coverage"? The linker needs -lgcov. If you pass --coverage to LDFLAGS, the link line will use it. autosetup: CFLAGS and LDFLAGS environment variables are respected. To be safe, set both:
- CFLAGS="-O2 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage"
- LDFLAGS="--coverage"

This way the library and binary will be linked with -lgcov. The .gcda files will be generated at runtime in the source directory.

After that, run make -j$(nproc) and make install (default prefix is /usr/local). /usr/local/bin is in PATH by default.
